reviews.summary: No current, directly relevant SOL risk was identified: Solana’s official status page reported all systems operational with no incidents through October 3, 2026. No fresh exploit, material unlock, delisting, or enforcement event was found.

facts.fact: Official Solana status showed Mainnet Beta, RPC nodes, Explorer, and solana.com operational; it listed no incidents for September 24–October 3, 2026. ([status.solana.com](https://status.solana.com/?utm_source=openai))

The official explorer showed Mainnet Beta producing blocks and processing transactions on October 3, 2026; this supports normal network operation near the signal time. ([explorer.solana.com](https://explorer.solana.com/?cluster=0&utm_source=openai))

A September testnet restart was resolved by September 14 and concerned Testnet rather than Mainnet Beta; it is not current direct evidence of a SOL spot-entry risk. ([github.com](https://github.com/anza-xyz/agave/wiki/2026-09-11-Testnet-Restart?utm_source=openai))

A scheduled staking-reward issuance was shown for October 11, 2026—about 401,600 SOL, or 0.068% of float—not an immediate large discrete unlock at the October 4 snapshot. ([investors.defillama.com](https://investors.defillama.com/unlocks/solana?utm_source=openai))
